description: Source code for a firmware image creation utility, including functions for handling firmware blocks, checksums, file I/O, and command-line argument parsing, specifically for ZyXEL firmware images.

classes.name: csum_state
classes.description: Structure for checksum calculation state, tracking odd byte, sum, and temporary byte.

classes.name: fw_block
classes.description: Represents a firmware block with alignment, filename, size, type, padding, and other metadata.

classes.name: fw_mmap
classes.description: Represents a memory map entry with address, size, and user address/size.

classes.name: board_info
classes.description: Contains information about a specific hardware board, including name, description, vendor ID, model ID, flash base, size, code start, firmware offset, and boot extension size.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating command-line argument parsing, processing firmware blocks, and generating firmware image file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the utility.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board configuration by name from predefined list.

methods.name: parse_opt_board
methods.description: Parses and sets the board option from command line.

methods.name: parse_opt_ofname
methods.description: Parses and sets the output filename option.

methods.name: parse_opt_block
methods.description: Parses and adds a firmware block (boot extension or raw) from command line.

methods.name: calc_block_offsets
methods.description: Calculates offsets for firmware blocks within flash size constraints.

methods.name: process_blocks
methods.description: Collects file sizes and calculates block offsets.

methods.name: write_out_image
methods.description: Writes the complete firmware image to output file, including headers, blocks, checksums, and padding.

methods.name: write_out_header
methods.description: Writes firmware header to output file.

methods.name: write_out_mmap
methods.description: Writes memory map information to output file.

methods.name: write_out_block
methods.description: Writes a firmware block's data to output file.

methods.name: write_out_file
methods.description: Reads a file and writes its contents to output file.

methods.name: block_stat_file
methods.description: Gets file size for a firmware block.

methods.name: read_magic
methods.description: Reads magic number from a boot extension file.
